summary: The proposed patch aims to improve the error message when accessing a non-existent attribute within a custom property of a subclassed SkyCoord. However, the implementation may introduce behavioral changes and lacks comprehensive testing.

issues.description: The change modifies the behavior of the __getattr__ method, which could lead to unintended side effects or break existing behavior that relies on the current error message.
There are no additional tests provided to verify the new behavior, especially for cases involving subclassed SkyCoords with custom properties.
